tickets.subject: Router replacement needed
tickets.description: Customer reported router stopped working after power surge.
tickets.resolution: Router replaced under warranty. New router provisioned and working.
tickets.agent_notes: Router model E400 replaced with E450. Customer confirmed connection restored.

tickets.subject: Slow internet speeds
tickets.description: Customer getting only 50 Mbps on FiberMax 200 plan.
tickets.resolution: Network team upgraded the fiber line in the area. Speed restored to 195 Mbps.
tickets.agent_notes: Line quality issue in area. NOC resolved.

tickets.subject: Billing question
tickets.description: Customer asked why bill showed pro-rata charge after plan upgrade.
tickets.resolution: Explained pro-rata billing per KB-004. Customer satisfied.
tickets.agent_notes: Standard explanation. No action required.

tickets.subject: Roaming data not working in Thailand
tickets.description: Customer in Bangkok, mobile data not connecting.
tickets.resolution: Reset APN settings remotely. Roaming re-registered. Data restored.
tickets.agent_notes: APN settings were corrupted after network update in Thailand.

tickets.subject: Internet disconnecting every 30 minutes
tickets.description: Router drops connection intermittently. Restarted 3 times.
tickets.agent_notes: Third occurrence in 60 days. Pattern suggests line instability. Field visit scheduled.

tickets.subject: Speed below expected - 200 Mbps instead of 500 Mbps
tickets.description: FiberMax 500 customer getting only 200 Mbps consistently.
tickets.resolution: Network ops upgraded segment. Speed restored.
tickets.agent_notes: Infrastructure bottleneck at junction box.

tickets.subject: Complete internet outage for 6 hours
tickets.description: No internet from 2PM to 8PM. Router showed red internet light.
tickets.resolution: Area outage. Service restored after emergency maintenance.
tickets.agent_notes: Billing credit of ₹300 applied per KB-001 outage policy.

tickets.subject: Account suspended - payment issue
tickets.description: Customer disputes suspension, claims payment was made.
tickets.agent_notes: Payment not reflected in system. Customer claims UPI transfer completed. Investigation ongoing. 3 months outstanding balance confirmed.

tickets.subject: Additional SIM not receiving calls
tickets.description: SIM-3 (child) not receiving incoming calls.
tickets.resolution: SIM-3 was locked due to 3 failed payment attempts on the parent account. Unlocked after payment cleared.
tickets.agent_notes: All SIMs on family account lock when primary account has payment issues.

tickets.subject: Internet speed very slow - 20 Mbps instead of 200 Mbps
tickets.description: Speed drastically reduced. Plan is FiberMax 200.
tickets.agent_notes: Area-wide investigation ongoing. Multiple customers affected.

tickets.subject: Router keeps disconnecting
tickets.description: Intermittent drops since area maintenance.
tickets.resolution: Temporary issue after planned maintenance. Resolved.
tickets.agent_notes: Related to maintenance on 2024-08-27.

tickets.subject: Bill doubled - disputes plan upgrade
tickets.description: Customer says their bill went from ₹899 to ₹1499. Claims they did not request an upgrade.
tickets.agent_notes: CONTRADICTION: System shows plan upgraded from FiberMax 200 to FiberMax 500 on 2024-08-20. Customer denies authorizing this change. Unauthorized upgrade investigation required.

tickets.subject: Unknown ₹175 charge on bill
tickets.description: Customer sees ₹175 extra on bill. No add-ons purchased.
tickets.agent_notes: Billing team alerted. Charge code unknown. Possible system error.

tickets.subject: No internet connection since activation
tickets.description: New customer, cannot connect at all. Router light shows red internet light.
tickets.agent_notes: Agent asked customer to restart router (already done). Red internet light = possible provisioning failure.

tickets.subject: SIM not working
tickets.description: SIM shows no service.
tickets.resolution: SIM was damaged. Replacement issued at store.
tickets.agent_notes: Physical SIM damage confirmed. First replacement, no charge.

tickets.subject: SIM replacement request
tickets.description: Customer requesting another SIM replacement.
tickets.agent_notes: Second replacement within 90 days. ₹99 fee applies per KB-006. Customer must be informed.

tickets.subject: Service restricted - payment dispute
tickets.description: Customer disputes overdue amount. Claims bill was paid.
tickets.agent_notes: Payment records show no payment received for August or September.

tickets.subject: Payment arrangement declined
tickets.description: Customer requested installment arrangement for overdue balance.
tickets.resolution: Arrangement declined - policy allows only one arrangement per year. Previous arrangement was in January.
tickets.agent_notes: Customer informed of policy limitation.

tickets.subject: Unusual data usage - 48GB claimed vs 10GB expected
tickets.description: Customer disputes 48GB data usage. Claims household usage was around 10GB.
tickets.agent_notes: Usage logs show 48GB. Possible background app usage or tethering by another device. Detailed usage breakdown requested.

tickets.subject: Disputed data pack purchase
tickets.description: ₹150 weekly pack charge disputed. Customer says they didn't buy it.
tickets.agent_notes: System shows pack purchased via MyAccount app on 2024-09-02 at 11:23 PM. Customer may have purchased accidentally.

tickets.subject: Data deletion request
tickets.description: Customer requests all personal data be deleted.
tickets.agent_notes: Referred to Privacy team per KB-015. Awaiting Privacy team action.

tickets.subject: Being billed after account closure
tickets.description: Customer claims account closed July 2024 but August and September bills received.
tickets.agent_notes: SERIOUS: Account shows as Active. No closure record found. System shows plan active, payments continuing. Full audit required.

tickets.subject: Router password forgotten
tickets.description: Customer forgot Wi-Fi password and cannot access router admin.
tickets.resolution: Guided customer to router admin panel. Password reset successfully.
tickets.agent_notes: Default admin IP 192.168.1.1 used. Standard troubleshooting.

tickets.subject: Data deletion request - active account
tickets.description: Customer wants data deleted but account is still active.
tickets.agent_notes: Per KB-015, deletion only for closed accounts (90+ days). Customer advised to close account first. Referred to Privacy team for guidance.

tickets.subject: Router offline after returning from travel
tickets.description: No internet since returning from a 2-week trip. Already restarted router twice.
tickets.agent_notes: Standard restart already tried x2. Escalate to check if IP lease expired or provisioning issue.
